title: Plynth custom trim profile, version 1
description: A custom cross section for skirting boards, cornices, casings, sills and railings, saved as Library/shapes/<id>.profile.json. The outline is drawn in a unit box: x from 0 at the wall to 1 out from it, y from 0 at the bottom to 1 at the top. It is stretched to the trim's depth and height. The outline is a simple closed polygon: the first point is not repeated, no two edges cross, it has an area, and its points reach all four sides of the box.

id.description: The id stored in project.json trim styles. Must differ from the built-in ids square, bevel, rounded, classic, cove and round.

name.description: Shown in the app's profile list.
